description: GCC Natural Gas Database is a dataset listed in Artificial Intelligence Global Company - ODS open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Joint Organisations Data Initiative. This dataset contains GCC Natural Gas Database for 2009-2021. Data from Joint Organizations Data Initiative. Export API data for more datasets to advance energy economics research. Coverage: Gulf Cooperation Council states. The portal files it under Oil & gas. The portal shows 5,393 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-03-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-aigc-portal.
